_comment: Applied ONLY to what the voice is given, never to what appears on screen. Whole-word, case-insensitive. Add an entry when a word is actually heard wrong, not on suspicion.
_comment_pauses: [[slnc N]] is macOS say's embedded silence (ms): used where the voice ran words together and changed the meaning (heard back through local whisper, 23/10: 'has written next to his email', 'goes to Adario', 'note in her reply. Anne approves').
note and her reply, and approves: note, [[slnc 120]] and her reply, [[slnc 200]] and approves
_comment_rate: [[rate N]] is say's embedded speaking rate: the sentence-final 'person approves' was drawn out (Claudia: 'peeeerson approves'); measured with whisper word timestamps, 23/10.
